description: Acceptance of a project team invitation. Written by the invited user in their own PDS. References the id.sifa.project.member invitation record. Both records existing = confirmed team member. Either party can delete their record to revoke membership.

main.description: Record representing acceptance of a project team invitation. Lives in the invited user's PDS.

project.description: StrongRef to the id.sifa.project.self record being joined.

invitation.description: StrongRef to the id.sifa.project.member invitation record that this acceptance corresponds to.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this acceptance was created.
